title: Code and data for: LLM Agent Leaderboards Often Cannot Separate Their Top Two Entries
description: Code and derived data accompanying the paper "LLM Agent Leaderboards Often Cannot Separate Their Top Two Entries". Contains the leaderboard census (item-sampling and fixed-task rerun bounds over 22 public agent leaderboards; derived per-entry statistics only), the Terminal-Bench 2.0 multi-run analysis, the robustness analyses (paired-test validation, calibration simulation, eligibility, multiplicity and missing-reward sensitivity), a small pinned harness illustration, and SepBound, a Python package and command-line tool that computes the item-sampling bound, leader posterior and leader set from published scores and task counts. Please cite the paper, not this record.
notes: Code: MIT. Derived data: CC BY 4.0. Raw leaderboard files are not redistributed.
